subtitle: Every non-conformance — a supplier's material, production, the warehouse, a customer's return — and its corrective action.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Number, title, reference, supplier or customer

emptyHint: Open a report when something does not conform: incoming material, a batch, a customer's return.

stageHints.open: Record the containment: what was done at once to stop it spreading (quarantine, sorting, stopping a line).
stageHints.investigation: Find the root cause; add a correction if one is needed now.
stageHints.action: Carry out the corrective actions; when all are finished, send the report to verification.
stageHints.verification: Check the actions worked (the problem did not come back). Effective closes the report.

sourceHints.incoming_material: Material received from a supplier (granules, masterbatch, cores, cartons, film…).
sourceHints.supplier: A supplier's service or document, beyond the material itself.
sourceHints.customer_return: Goods a customer returned or complained about.

kindHints.correction: Fixes what happened now (sort, rework, return).
kindHints.corrective: Removes the cause, so it does not happen again.
kindHints.preventive: Stops it happening elsewhere (other lines, other suppliers).

supplierActionHints.notify: The supplier is told; nothing is asked back.
supplierActionHints.return_goods: The material goes back to the supplier.
supplierActionHints.scar: The supplier must find the cause and answer with its corrective action; record its answer here.

fields.title: Title
fields.no_action_justification: Why no corrective action is needed
fields.evidence: Evidence (what was done, where it can be seen)

placeholders.supplierReference: Delivery or invoice no., supplier's lot

costsHint: Optional: what the non-conformance cost, and what is claimed back from the party responsible.
moneyHint: Amounts are numbers with up to two decimals.
itemsHint: Each item needs a name and a problem; the quantity is a number.
formSubtitle: Numbered NCR-YYYY-NNNN; then worked through its stages.
lockedHint: A closed or cancelled report cannot be changed.
filesHint: An image or PDF, 10 MB at most: the defect, the lot label, the supplier's answer.

containDialog.title: Containment
containDialog.text: What was done at once to stop the problem spreading? The investigation starts next.

investigateDialog.title: Root cause
investigateDialog.text: Why did it happen? Choose the category and describe the analysis.
investigateDialog.noAction: A minor, isolated case: no corrective action is needed
investigateDialog.recurring: This problem repeats earlier reports: it is not an isolated case and needs a corrective action.

verifyDialog.title: Verify effectiveness
verifyDialog.text: Did the actions work? Check that the problem did not come back.
verifyDialog.reviewHint: To confirm the problem did not come back; it then appears in the follow-ups of whoever verified it.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the report
cancelDialog.text: Raised by mistake or a duplicate? Give the reason.

errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.NCR_IS_FINAL: The report is closed or cancelled.
errors.ROOT_CAUSE_REQUIRED: Choose the cause category and describe the root cause.
errors.NO_ACTION_JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED: Say why no corrective action is needed.
errors.ROOT_CAUSE_METHOD_UNKNOWN: Choose the method from the list.
errors.NCR_NOT_IN_ACTION: Actions are added while investigating or acting.
errors.ACTION_REQUIRED: At least one action must be done.
errors.NCR_NOT_IN_VERIFICATION: The report is not waiting for verification.
errors.VERIFICATION_NOTES_REQUIRED: Say why the actions were not effective.
errors.ACTION_KIND_UNKNOWN: Choose the kind from the list.
errors.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: The production order was not found.
errors.SEVERITY_UNKNOWN: Choose the severity from the list.
errors.SUPPLIER_ACTION_UNKNOWN: Choose the action with the supplier from the list.
errors.CLAIM_STATUS_UNKNOWN: Choose the claim status from the list.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.FILE_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Only images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and PDF files.
errors.FILE_INVALID_PATH: The file could not be saved.
errors.RECURRING_NEEDS_ACTION: This problem repeats earlier reports: it needs a corrective action.
errors.EFFECTIVENESS_REVIEW_NOT_PENDING: No effectiveness review is pending on this report.
errors.REVIEW_NOTES_REQUIRED: Say how the problem came back.
errors.FILE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The organization's storage is full: the file was not uploaded.
errors.FILE_INVALID_IMAGE: The image could not be read.
errors.FILE_INVALID_PDF: The PDF file is incomplete or damaged.
errors.APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: You hold no authority to verify, directly or by a delegation in force.

recurrence.title: Recurrence
recurrence.hint: Reports in the {days} days before this one, or after it, about the same supplier, item or cause.
recurrence.recurringHint: {count} earlier reports in {days} days repeat this one: it needs a corrective action that removes the cause.
recurrence.sinceClosing: {count} similar reports were raised after this one was closed.

review.title: Effectiveness review
review.text: Some time after closing: did the problem come back?
review.effective: Effective — it did not come back
review.reopens: The report reopens to its corrective actions.
review.scheduled: Effectiveness to be reviewed again on {date}.
